description: Open a support ticket with EQVPS. `subject` and `message` are required; optional `service_id` ties it to one of your VPS. The response includes the ticket `code` — use that with get_ticket / reply_ticket / close_ticket.

service_id.description: Service code as returned by list_vps/order_vps, e.g. "68J67T5" (a plain numeric id is also accepted).

name: create_ticket
title: Open a support ticket
